verdict.rationale: A national company registry could plausibly publish a public data API, so this axis applies. The evidence pack holds only two probes recording HTTP 403 at robots.txt on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in. Nothing documents published endpoints, a key-issuance path, or stated rate limits, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, the service documents a public API for its data — published endpoints, a key-issuance path, and stated rate limits on its own pages
